name: svartalfar_horseman
description: a Svartalfar Horseman, a dark elf with pale grey skin, long white-lavender hair and pointed ears, in black-and-silver armour with a purple cape, a round black shield with a silver rim and boss on his RIGHT arm and a long spear with a steel leaf blade in his LEFT hand, riding a black horse with a black mane and tail, a silver-studded bridle and a purple saddle cloth trimmed in silver
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round black shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
